name: Portsmouth city, VA
findings: Portsmouth city has 305 nonprofit organizations. 117 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Portsmouth city has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 29 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 8 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
